exports.name: CardSlotIconProps

exports.name: CardSlotTypographyProps
exports.note: Not exported; take the props from `TypographyProps` (`@gild-ui/react/Typography`).

exports.name: ComponentStyle
exports.note: Not exported; a style from `theme.components` is `CSSObject` or `({ theme, ownerState }) => CSSObject`.

exports.name: ComponentVariant
exports.note: Not exported; a variant is `{ props, style }`, typed through `ThemeComponents`.

exports.name: TabsVariants
exports.note: No longer an augmentable interface: a Tabs look is declared by a registered theme (`components.Tabs.variants`); `TabsVariant` (from `@gild-ui/react/Tabs`) is the union.
